name: WPS知识库
description: WPS/zhishi knowledge base CLI: list spaces, file trees, ask (SSE), share links, and skills_hub file CRUD.
description_zh: 通过自然语言操作 WPS/zhishi 云端知识库：列出知识库、浏览文件树、智能问答、分享链接，以及文件/文件夹增删改查。
description_en: Operate WPS/zhishi cloud knowledge bases with natural language: list spaces, browse file trees, ask questions, share links, and manage files.
examples_zh: 打开个人知识库看文件树
在知识库里问：上周项目进度总结
给这个知识库文件生成分享链接
在知识库里新建一个文件夹叫会议纪要
examples_en: Show the file tree of my personal knowledge base
Ask the knowledge base: summarize last week's project progress
Create a share link for this knowledge base file
Create a folder named Meeting Notes in the knowledge base
